notes: Getty AAT terms the library blesses: every term on linked.art's required, recommended and optional vocabulary pages (https://linked.art/model/vocab/), plus a small 'documented' tier of structural terms the model documentation uses that those lists omit. Labels are those linked.art's own examples write for the id, else the vocabulary page's. Instances (people, places) and dataset-specific concepts are deliberately absent: construct them with Aat.Of(id, label), Tgn.Of(id, label) and Ulan.PersonOf(id, label). Regenerate src/LinkedArtNet/Vocabulary/Aat.g.cs with: dotnet run --project tools/VocabGen
